text: Quick heads up from Orbit: the surround-view cameras run for Huntsville can't make it Monday Mar 29. Carrier says Thursday Apr 1 now (a customs inspection).

summary: E-09 is Supplier delay. 6 production orders move (4 rescheduled, 2 transferred). 26 dealer notice(s) and 10 loaner assignment(s).
reasoning: Walked SH-0256 → CAM-360 → SUMMIT, VOYAGER (bill of materials) → production orders at P_AL from 2027-03-29 up to 2027-04-01. 6 orders need the delayed part. Rule 1 and rule 3. Placed 4 at the same plant and transferred 2. Rule 4: 26 dealer notice(s), one each, listing only affected customer orders. Rule 5: 10 loaner(s) for Platinum and Gold in priority order; 2 entitled order(s) left without a car because the pool ran out. Standard customers are on the dealer notice only. Guardrail: only orders, vehicles, dealers, and customers reached by the walk are touched. Shared slots and loaner pools are one board for the whole event, so a compound message cannot double-book them.

handoffs.did: Split the message into 1 incident(s) and dispatched specialists.
